content.text: AdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementTRENDINGOhtani's 6-inning scoreless debutLeBron passes KareemD-backs rookie makes historyTiger's troublesGoodell addresses Rooney RuleStory byLansing State JournalDan Basso, Lansing State JournalFri, Mar 13, 2026·1 min readAdd Yahoo Sports on GoogleThe University of Michigan men's basketball team is ranked No. 3 and set to play in the Big Ten Tournament quarterfinals on Friday after winning the regular season crown.The Wolverines, 29-2 and 18-1, are set to play at noon Friday, March 13, at the United Center in Chicago, the site of this year's tournament, against Ohio State.AdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementMichigan a bye into the quarterfinals while Ohio State defeated Iowa 72-69 Thursday night, March 12.The Wolverines are 11-0 on the road and 4-1 at neutral sites this season. Ohio State is 21-11 overall.Here's how to watch the Wolverines game.What time is the UM basketball game Friday?The Wolverines play Ohio State at noon, Friday, March 13.What channel is the Michigan game on Friday?Friday's game will be broadcast on the Big Ten Network.Michigan's radio network includes WWJ-AM (950 in Detroit) as well as more than a dozen stations across Michigan.The game is available on SiriusXM Channel 84.AdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementWhat is Michigan's record?UM is 29-2 overall and 18-1 in the Big Ten regular season. Losing to both Duke and Wisconsin. Michigan is 4-1 at neutral sites.This article originally appeared on Detroit Free Press: Michigan basketball game.
